question: Create an inventory of the data in fixtures/raw_data and what processing it needs to be AI ready and available on my network.
ground_truth: nv-curate --action plan scans the raw dir, reports file/row counts, columns, image presence, PHI risk, and the needed steps (anonymize, translate, structure, classify), and writes a datasources.json plan.
expected_behavior: the skill runs with --action plan on the raw directory
output.inventory reports n_report_files, n_report_rows, has_images, and phi_risk
output.plan lists pipeline.steps = [anonymize, translate, structure, classify]
a datasources.json plan file is written
the agent does NOT claim the data is already de-identified or AI-ready

question: Extract the reports, de-identify, translate, structure, and save the AI-ready dataset using the plan in fixtures/datasources.json.
ground_truth: nv-curate --action curate runs anonymize -> translate -> structure -> classify on the configured raw data and assembles an AI-ready datalist (curated_records.json + datalist.json) joined by study_uid.
expected_behavior: the skill runs with --action curate on datasources.json
the agent reports per-stage metrics (phi_leak_rate, qc pass rates, label coverage) from the stages list
the agent notes mock vs live mode honestly (mock is not regulatory de-identification)

question: Use nv-curate to retrieve and transform the data in fixtures/datasources.json and use it to fine-tune the MR-brain diffusion model.
ground_truth: nv-curate --action finetune runs the curation pipeline, builds the MONAI datalist, and reports hand-off readiness for nv-generate-mr-brain-finetune. With no image volumes joined (text-only fixture), the hand-off is reported not-ready with the reason, and the analysis dataset (reports + labels) is produced.
expected_behavior: output.finetune_handoff names skill nv-generate-mr-brain-finetune and provides a datalist + command
when no images are joined, finetune_handoff.ready is false with a clear reason (image track required)
the agent does NOT fabricate a successful diffusion finetune when no image volumes are present
